hook: Harry Potter, but if *Draco was a girl*
caption:
The internet has turned Draco Malfoy into a girl, and AI is helping turn the idea into something that looks like a real Harry Potter movie.

It all started with fan art of a female Draco Malfoy, now known online as Malfoid. What began as a simple character redesign quickly grew into a viral trend, with fans creating their own stories, artwork, and increasingly impressive AI-generated videos.

And that's where things get interesting.

For decades, fans have written their own versions of their favorite stories, imagining different characters, relationships, and entire worlds that never made it to the screen.

Now, with AI video tools, those same ideas can become cinematic scenes that millions of people can watch and share.

This fan-made Harry Potter trailer is one example of how quickly internet culture is changing.

What would you want to see turned into a movie?
